notes: Two distinct path families depending on camera generation. Older HD/Full HD models (e.g. IN-9008, IN-8003, IN-6012): bare /11 /12 /13. Newer WQHD/2K+/QFHD models (e.g. IN-9408, IN-9420, IN-9808, IN-8401, IN-8403): /livestream/11 /livestream/12 /livestream/13. In both families, stream 11 = main (highest res), 12 = sub (mid), 13 = third (lowest/mobile). Default RTSP port is 554 (configurable in camera UI). Codec is model/profile-dependent and not stated in the wiki streaming pages. URL format: rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:{port}/livestream/11 (newer) or rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:{port}/11 (older). DDNS access supported using the same paths.
